source_caption_text:
Rapper #BloodhoundLilSpeedy recently shared a heartbreaking memory involving “Poohman” (BloodHound/Drill City), reflecting on a time when the two were beginning to rebuild their bond and get back to the relationship they once had.

According to Speedy, just as they were getting close again, Poohman’s life was tragically cut short💔🕊️

The loss was reportedly part of an incredibly difficult stretch for Speedy, who says he lost two close friends, BloodHound Q50 and Poohman, within the span of just one week in separate incidents involving g-n v*olence.

Losing someone is already difficult enough, but losing multiple people you love in such a short period of time can leave an impact that lasts forever. Speedy’s story is a reminder of how quickly circumstances can change and how important it can be to reconnect with the people you care about while you still have the opportunity.

Rest in peace Q50 & Poohman 🕊️💔
